data.one_liner: A Dart library for chess rules, move generation, and FEN/PGN parsing with variant support.
data.what_it_does: Provides immutable chess position handling, legal move generation, and game outcome detection. Includes FEN/PGN read/write and support for Chess960 and several chess variants.
use_when: You need chess logic on native Flutter apps
You require move generation and board state handling without UI components
avoid_when: You need a full UI chess board widget
strengths: Supports multiple chess variants and Chess960
